create_timer_instance: create a Timer instance to track elapsed time for code blocks
start_timer_tic: start a Timer by calling the tic method to record the start time
stop_timer_toc: stop a Timer by calling the toc method to get elapsed time since tic
get_average_time: get the average elapsed time across multiple tic/toc calls using toc with average=True
review_timer_class: review the Timer class and its tic and toc methods for timing code execution
